envelope.description: Implement common reviewer policy and complete chunk/result validation

body.title: Implement common reviewer policy and complete chunk/result validation
body.summary: Add proposed policy.ts and results.ts for guidelines+paths prompts, coherent DEF/HLD/LLD chunking, full inventory mapping and final consistency checks. Validate results and derive final status/counts from accepted feedback without another re-verdict model call.
acceptanceChecks: Prompt uses live subject/context/checkpoint paths and trailing schema; artifact-body canary and baseline are absent.
Plans reject missing/unknown units, final-only coverage, duplicate ids, cycles, bad ordering and missing final consistency.
DEF/HLD/LLD guidelines retain appropriate semantic concerns, and final alignment uses real Epic, standalone scope or ISSUE context.
Assigned required coverage is inspected or named as unverified/incomplete; HIGH/MED, LOW/advice and incomplete precedence are consistent across reviewer parties.
Consolidation preserves all accepted results, counts finding IDs consistently and does not manufacture evidence or run another review call.

tests.name: DEF/HLD/LLD prompts contain policy/paths/trailing schema without artifact-body canary or copied baseline.
Coverage plan rejects omitted/unknown units, final-only coverage, cycles, duplicate ids and bad final consistency.
Required verification gaps cannot pass; HIGH/MED and incomplete precedence, LOW/advice separation and deterministic counts preserve findings.
